name: ContentNavigation
description: A navigation pattern for content pages that provides previous/next links with smooth transitions. Features desktop sticky navigation (fixed to viewport sides) and mobile bottom navigation. Includes delayed visibility for smooth page transitions and text truncation for long titles.
usage: Use for navigating between sequential content items (e.g., blog posts, articles, case studies)
Desktop view shows fixed chevron buttons on left/right sides of viewport with hover-revealed titles
Mobile view shows bottom navigation with vertical layout and truncated titles
Component is hidden on initial render and fades in after a configurable delay to allow page transitions to complete
Automatically scrolls to top when navigation links are clicked
Optional back link can be displayed in mobile view for returning to index/list page
design: Desktop navigation uses fixed positioning at viewport edges (left: 8rem, right: 8rem)
Chevron buttons use rounded-full shape with bg-[var(--color-surface-card)]
Titles appear on hover with slide-in animation and bg-[var(--color-accent)]
Mobile navigation uses smaller circular buttons with titles shown below
Opacity transitions (300ms duration) provide smooth fade-in effect
Mobile titles are truncated with ellipsis (default 30 chars, configurable via truncateLength)
Back link appears with border-top separator in mobile view
accessibility: Desktop navigation links include descriptive aria-labels: 'Previous: {title}' and 'Next: {title}'
Clicking navigation links scrolls to top with 'instant' behavior for immediate navigation
Chevron icons are from lucide-react for consistent vector rendering
Text truncation preserves readability while preventing layout overflow

props.name: previous
props.description: The previous content item with title and slug. Pass null if there is no previous item.

props.name: next
props.description: The next content item with title and slug. Pass null if there is no next item.

props.name: basePath
props.description: The base URL path for content items (e.g., '/journal' or '/work'). Used to construct navigation URLs.

props.name: backLinkText
props.description: Optional text for back link to index page. When provided, displays a back link in mobile view with chevron icon.

props.name: mobilePosition
props.description: Controls vertical position of mobile navigation. 'bottom' adds mt-16 spacing, 'top' removes it.

props.name: displayMode
props.description: Controls which navigation parts are displayed. 'all' shows both desktop and mobile, 'desktop-only' hides mobile, 'mobile-only' hides desktop.

props.name: delayMs
props.description: Delay in milliseconds before showing navigation. Allows page transition to complete before navigation fades in.

props.name: truncateLength
props.description: Maximum length of title before truncation with ellipsis. If not provided, desktop titles are not truncated. Mobile view uses 30 characters as default if not specified.

subcomponents.name: ContentItem
subcomponents.description: Interface for content items used in navigation

props.name: title
props.description: Display text for the content item

props.name: slug
props.description: URL slug for the content item, combined with basePath to create the navigation URL
